pages.title: Possession Rituals
pages.text: Possession rituals bind spirits into living beings, giving the summoner a degree of control over the possessed being.$(br2)As such these rituals are used to obtain rare items without having to venture into dangerous places.$()

pages.title: Possession Rituals
pages.text: $(br2)Possessed Mobs count as their vanilla counterparts for the ritual sacrifices purposes.$(br)
